payload.description_html: Three-dimensional geometric morphospace of extant Palaeognathae (yellow), Galliformes (red), Anseriformes (pink), and Neoaves (blue), combined with selected fossils including Janavis (1), Dasornis (4), and Anatalavis/Nettapterornis (5). Extant taxa labelled are Struthio (2) and Rhea (3), Anas (6), Lophophorus (7), Scolopax (8), and Trogon (9). Modified from Benito et al. (2022b).
